judgments.reason: The specification claims commission is applied before payment allowing overbids, but the rules state the winner pays the bid, then receives the three-coin commission; the model did not articulate the claimed mechanism.

The hypothesis asserts waiting reveals sealed rival bids, but the rules say commitments are sealed and only resolved when all three have committed and only resolved bids are normally public; the model did not claim this mechanism.

The claim that close settles even with unauctioned lots contradicts the rule text '[close: 1] settles after all three lots are sold.' The model did not articulate the asserted alternative terminal mechanism.

The hypothesis that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission is inconsistent with the rules which state the commission is given to the auction winner and that catalog items are not auction wins; the model did not articulate this mechanism.
